package onboarding

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

// PathOutcomeHandler consumes Planner's durable S9 terminal fact. Correlation
// is performed only through the immutable S8 handoff ledger; Student/Dialog
// IDs from the event are never used as a lookup shortcut.
type PathOutcomeHandler struct {
	Handoffs  repository.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeCorrelator
	Outcomes  repository.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeStore
	Readiness repository.TeacherLearningReadinessResolver
	Dialogs   repository.DialogTeacherProactiveAppender
	Clock     Clock
}

func (handler PathOutcomeHandler) Handle(ctx context.Context, raw domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome) (bool, error) {
	outcome, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome(raw)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if handler.Handoffs == nil || handler.Outcomes == nil || handler.Readiness == nil || handler.Dialogs == nil || handler.Clock == nil {
		return false, errors.New("teacher onboarding path outcome dependencies are required")
	}
	handoff, found, err := handler.Handoffs.GetByPlannerHandoffID(ctx, outcome.HandoffID)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if !found || handoff.StudentID != outcome.StudentID || handoff.DialogID != outcome.DialogID || handoff.CommandTeacherJobID != outcome.TeacherJobID || handoff.PlannerHandoffID != outcome.HandoffID {
		return false, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome
	}
	if err := handler.validateAuthoritativeStatus(ctx, outcome, handoff); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	record, created, err := handler.Outcomes.Accept(ctx, domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord{
		Outcome: outcome, PersonalTeacherID: handoff.PersonalTeacherID,
		Body: domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeBody(handoff.Locale, outcome.Status), AcceptedAt: handler.Clock.Now().UTC(),
	})
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if record.DeliveredAt != nil {
		return created, nil
	}
	binding, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogBinding(domain.TeacherDialogBinding{
		ID: outcome.DialogID, StudentID: outcome.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: handoff.PersonalTeacherID,
		ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	message, err := handler.Dialogs.AppendTeacherProactive(ctx, binding, outcome.EventID, record.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if message.DialogID != outcome.DialogID || message.PersonalTeacherID != handoff.PersonalTeacherID || message.Body != record.Body || message.Version < 1 {
		return false, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome
	}
	if err := handler.Outcomes.MarkDelivered(ctx, outcome.EventID, message.ID, handler.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return created, nil
}

func (handler PathOutcomeHandler) validateAuthoritativeStatus(ctx context.Context, outcome domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome, handoff domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent) error {
	switch outcome.Status {
	case domain.TeacherOnboardingPathReady:
		// Planner's PATH_READY payload is the durable commit fact. Ensure will
		// re-read the authoritative Student/Planner readiness before presenting
		// ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS to the browser.
		return nil
	case domain.TeacherOnboardingPathActiveExists:
		readiness, err := handler.Readiness.ResolveLearningReadiness(ctx, handoff.StudentID, handoff.StateRef)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		readiness, err = domain.NormalizeTeacherLearningReadiness(readiness, &handoff.StateRef)
		if err != nil || readiness.Result != domain.TeacherLearningReadinessNotReady || len(readiness.ReasonCodes) != 1 || readiness.ReasonCodes[0] != domain.TeacherReadinessReasonActivePathExists || readiness.ActivePath == nil {
			return domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome
		}
		return nil
	case domain.TeacherOnboardingPathStateChanged:
		_, err := handler.Readiness.ResolveLearningReadiness(ctx, handoff.StudentID, handoff.StateRef)
		if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherLearningReadinessStale) {
			if err == nil {
				return domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome
			}
			return err
		}
		return nil
	default:
		return domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome
	}
}
